summary: Split lib/i18n.ts (75 inlined locale dictionaries, 2,135,813 source bytes) into lazy public/i18n/app/<locale>.json assets, compiled only the ko/en fallback pair into the shell, and excluded the i18n chunk from the entry document's modulepreload set.

method.build: pnpm run build (tsc + vite build), same worktree, before and after
method.caveat: StudioPage.tsx was being edited concurrently by another agent during the after-build; the +4.7 KiB drift in StudioPage entry and Studio-route-after-app-shell comes from that, not from this change. Every i18n-attributable delta below is isolated to the app entry graph and the i18n chunk.

localeAudit.note: Measured by importing the pre-change DICT and diffing every locale against en, key by key.
localeAudit.byteIdenticalToEnglishNote: Only en itself. The startup-findings claim that 67 locales are byte-identical to English overstates the mechanism: every locale differs in at least 12 keys. The substance holds — those 12-15 keys are nav/common labels and 97%+ of each locale renders English.

navigationLabelsOnly.threshold: 0.0228 - 0.0286 of en keys distinct (12-15 nav/common labels)

lazyLocaleAssets.loadedPerSession: 0 for ko/en (compiled into the shell), otherwise exactly 1 for the active locale

sourceFile.note: The dictionaries left; an explicit lazy loader, fallback-status contract and asset parser arrived.

entryModulePreload.contract: ENTRY_PRELOAD_EXCLUSIONS in vite.config.ts, enforced by scripts/check-studio-bundle.mjs against dist/index.html
entryModulePreload.tradeoff: The i18n chunk is still a static dependency of the app entry, so dropping the modulepreload costs one round trip of discovery latency after the entry chunk parses. At 18.6 KiB gzip that is a far better trade than competing with the entry script and the render-blocking stylesheet for first-round-trip bandwidth.

fallbackContract.chain: requested locale (and its parents) -> en -> ko -> raw key
fallbackContract.assetResolution: resolveAppI18nAssetLocale() narrows a request to a published asset using the candidate chain WITHOUT the fallback chain, so "no dictionary published" stays distinguishable from "English dictionary published"
fallbackContract.observability: getAppI18nLocaleStatus(locale) always reports which asset served the locale and why it fell back; a failed load also warns once on the console
fallbackContract.emptyStringFix: resolveTranslation now treats a defined key as an answer instead of a truthy one. en publishes "" for ageGate.yearSuffix/monthSuffix/daySuffix and authors.people; the previous truthiness test skipped those and rendered the Korean units to every non-Korean locale.

regressionGates: scripts/check-studio-bundle.mjs: dist/index.html must not modulepreload any ENTRY_PRELOAD_EXCLUSIONS chunk (hard failure)
scripts/check-studio-bundle.mjs: no app-shell i18n chunk may exceed 256 KiB raw (hard failure)
lib/__tests__/i18n-locale-assets.test.ts: generated catalog must match the assets on disk, every asset must cover the 525-key baseline, only the active locale loads, fallback states are explicit
